answer: A terrace ladder starts each identity at the bottom. Climbing needs three lantern-signed orchard seasons, one epoch of work each, bound to that key. Registration locks a 100-credit bond plus a 150-credit deposit, released only after the third season. Each fake pays the same 250 credits and waits three seasons, so 1,000 fakes tie up 250,000 credits, with no pooling across identities. A rented-season ring fails: a season signed for another key does not match, and the deposit burns. An honest agent pays one bond and one deposit and recovers the deposit after three seasons.
